'''Liu Sifeng''' ({{zh|s=刘思峰}}; born 15 July 1955) is a Chinese systems engineer.  He was the director of the Institute for Grey Systems Studies at [[Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics]], Nanjing, China.  He is best known for his work on [[grey system theory]].

==Education and career==
Liu obtained his [[Bachelor of Engineering|BE]] in Mathematics from [[Henan University]] in 1981, then his MS in Economics (1986) and PhD in Systems Engineering (1998) from [[Huazhong University of Science and Technology]], Wuhan, China.<ref name="cv2014">{{cite web|url= http://www.dmu.ac.uk/documents/technology-documents/research-faculties/cci/cv-sifeng-liu.pdf |title=Curriculum Vita|last=Liu|first=Sifeng|access-date=11 June 2021}}</ref>  He was the doctoral student of [[Julong Deng]], the founder of grey system theory.<ref name="editorial2021"/>

Liu was appointed as a lecturer at Henan University in 1985.  He was promoted through the ranks, reaching full professor in 1994.  In 2000, he moved as a distinguished professor <!--disinguished is part of the title--> to [[Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics]], where he also serves as director of the Institute for Grey Systems Studies.  In 2014, he worked as a research professor <!-- research is part of the title --> at [[De Montfort University]] in [[Leicester, UK]].<ref name="cv2014"/><ref name="editorial2021">{{cite journal |last1=Javed |first1=Saad Ahmed |title=Editorial |journal=Grey Systems: Theory and Application |date=2021-06-18 |volume=11 |issue=3 |pages=2043–9377 |doi=10.1108/GS-06-2021-169 |s2cid=235826478 |url=https://www.emerald.com/insight/content/doi/10.1108/GS-06-2021-169/full/html|url-access=subscription }}</ref>{{better source needed|date=June 2021|reason=the editorial in a journal that he is editor for fails independence; one would expect to have a Nanjing University page confirming his appointment and position}}

Liu is the editor-in-chief of ''Grey Systems: Theory and Application'',<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.emeraldgrouppublishing.com/journal/gs#editorial-team|title=Journal Description|publisher=[[Emerald Publishing]]|work=Grey Systems|access-date=11 June 2021}}</ref> and of the ''Journal of Grey System''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.researchinformation.co.uk/grey.php|work=Journal of Grey System|title=Official Webpage|access-date=11 June 2021}}</ref>

In 2013, he became the Fellow of [[Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Xie |first=Naiming |last2=Jopling |first2=Daniel |date=2014-09-01 |title=Prof. Sifeng Liu selected for Marie Curie International Incoming Fellowship |url=https://go.gale.com/ps/i.do?p=AONE&sw=w&issn=09573720&v=2.1&it=r&id=GALE%7CA442782377&sid=googleScholar&linkaccess=abs |journal=The Journal of Grey System |language=English |volume=26 |issue=3}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
Liu is an honorary fellow of the World Organisation of Systems and Cybernetics,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://wosc.co/distinctions-and-awards/|title=Distinctions and Awards|date=29 November 2011 |publisher=World Organisation of Systems and Cybernetics|access-date=12 June 2021}}</ref> and an honorary editor of "International Journal of Grey Systems" (USA).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Editorial Board|url=http://publish.thescienceinsight.com/index.php/ijgs/about/editorialTeam|access-date=2021-03-25|website=International Journal of Grey Systems}}</ref>  German Chancellor [[Angela Merkel]] mentioned Liu's contributions to grey system theory in a 2019 speech at Huazhong University of Science and Technology.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bundeskanzlerin.de/bkin-de/aktuelles/rede-von-bundeskanzlerin-merkel-an-der-huazhong-university-of-science-and-technology-am-7-september-2019-in-wuhan-1668736|title=Rede von Bundeskanzlerin Merkel an der Huazhong University of Science and Technology am 7. September 2019 in Wuhan|lang=de|trans-title=Speech by Chancellor Merkel at the Huazhong University of Science and Technology on September 7, 2019 in Wuhan|publisher=Die Bundeskanzlerin|date=7 September 2019|access-date=25 June 2021}}</ref> In 2023, he received the Global Excellence Award from the Grey Systems Society of Pakistan.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Professor Sifeng Liu won the Global Excellence Award {{!}} Emerald Publishing |url=https://www.emeraldgrouppublishing.com/journal/gs/professor-sifeng-liu-won-global-excellence-award |access-date=2023-12-11 |website=www.emeraldgrouppublishing.com |language=en}}</ref>
